comment: Committed defaults for worker assignment; settings.json in the app's userData folder overrides these (edit via the in-app Settings panel). Providers: 'mock' (no API key needed), 'anthropic' (needs ANTHROPIC_API_KEY), 'openrouter' (key saved via Settings). The executor worker is the app-wide default used when a node template sets no worker; categoryWorkers apply when a node declares a category (see FLOW_NODES.md).
